title: Typed universal finite change-of-rings pair
statement:
Let k be a field, l a prime, E a finite-dimensional field extension of Q_l and n,j natural numbers with j ≤ n. For the canonical map of constant coefficient ring sheaves A_n → A_j on the pro-etale site of Spec k, there exists a typed PointFiniteReductionSheafModel. Its ordinary functor has the prescribed sheafified tensor objects and maps and is additive; its derived functor and homotopy counit form the universal left derived pair, it is triangulated, and its counit is invertible on every K-flat complex. This is the homotopy form of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], packaged without expanding nested existential projections.
Definitions and coefficient conventions: [def-weil-affine-spectrum], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf].

proof.text: Specialize the existing independent-coefficient derivedChangeOfRingsIndependentCoefficients theorem at the constant finite coefficient sheaf map. Its ordinary object and map equations fix the sheafified extension functor. Unpack its existential witness and assemble the ordinary functor, additive instance, derived functor, homotopy counit, universal property, triangulatedness, and K-flat computation into PointFiniteReductionSheafModel. The derived pair is determined up to its unique counit-compatible isomorphism. No arbitrary object is selected from mere existence.
